generate_expansion_circular: generate a circular-truncated basis expansion for a square lattice with approximately 20 terms
generate_expansion_parallelogramic: generate a parallelogramic-truncated basis expansion for a rectangular lattice with approximately 25 terms
brillouin_zone_in_plane_wavevector: compute the in-plane wavevector grid for a given Brillouin zone shape and primitive lattice vectors
plane_wave_in_plane_wavevector: compute the in-plane wavevector from wavelength, polar angle, azimuthal angle, and permittivity values
unit_cell_coordinates: generate unit cell coordinate arrays for a given shape and number of unit cells along each axis
